title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Astute Recruitment are working with an established business in Burntwood to recruit an Accounts Assistant on a permanent, part-time basis. This is an excellent opportunity for an all-round finance professional looking to develop their technical accounting experience and take on greater responsibility over time. Working closely with the Finance Director within a small, stable finance team, you'll gain exposure to all aspects of the accounts function, with the role moving to full-time in 2028 and offering genuine long-term progression.

The Role Will Involve:
- Managing Sales Ledger, Purchase Ledger and Nominal Ledger activities
- Preparing accruals and prepayments
- Maintaining fixed asset records and processing stock invoices
- Managing currency gains and losses, including hedging
- Completing bank reconciliations
- Processing supplier payments and company credit cards
- Supporting month-end, quarter-end and year-end management accounts
- Assisting with financial analysis, reporting and reconciliations
- Supporting audit preparation and parent company reporting where required

The Ideal Candidate:
- Around 3 years' experience in an all-round finance or accounts role
- Good understanding of core accounting principles and financial processes
- Experience across ledgers, reconciliations and month-end activities
- Strong attention to detail and analytical skills
- Organised, proactive and comfortable working independently
- Audit preparation and parent company reporting experience would be advantageous
- Keen to develop, learn additional responsibilities and progress within a finance function

Benefits & Hours:
- Salary: Approximately 25,000 for 30 hours per week
- Six hours per day, with a 5pm finish
- Flexible start times
- Opportunity to move into a full-time position in 2028
- 20 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Basic company pension
- Small, stable finance team with excellent staff longevity

title: HR and Payroll Assistant (Maternity Cover)
company: Jonathan Lee Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Contract
description:
If you're looking for a rewarding entry point into HR operations with payroll responsibility, this HR and Payroll Assistant (Maternity Cover) role is a brilliant opportunity to make an immediate impact. Expect hands-on work, strong cross-functional exposure with HR, Finance and managers, and a clear, structured route to owning key employee lifecycle and payroll admin activities. The HR and Payroll Assistant (Maternity Cover) position is ideal if you love detail, enjoy improving processes, and want your work to be felt every month as teams and payroll run smoothly.

What You Will Do:
- Support hiring managers through the recruitment process, including managing applications and coordinating interviews via the applicant tracking system.
- Manage new starter administration, including onboarding documentation, right to work checks and pre-employment processes.
- Handle employee lifecycle administration such as contractual changes, probation support, absence management and leaver processing.
- Input and collate monthly payroll changes and liaise with Finance to support accurate and timely payroll processing.
- Maintain and correct employee data across systems, including SAP, BrightHR, ATLAS and internal platforms, ensuring data integrity.
- Assist with employee relations administration at Level 0 and Level 1 by responding to routine queries and supporting managers with casework administration.

What You Will Bring:
- Proven experience in a similar HR, payroll or people administration role, with confidence processing payroll changes.
- CIPD Level 3 (or equivalent) is essential, with further HR study viewed positively.
- Strong working knowledge of UK employment law and HR best practice, with the ability to apply it accurately.
- Experience with pension administration, including managing uploads and changes in line with relevant deadlines.
- Excellent systems skills and high attention to detail, alongside strong organisational and communication abilities.

This HR and Payroll Assistant (Maternity Cover) role sits within the engineering and technology industry and helps this company keep HR administration reliable, compliant and efficient. By supporting recruitment coordination, onboarding, employee lifecycle administration and payroll change input, you help maintain a smooth employee experience while also supporting continuous improvement in processes and controls.

Location:

Lichfield, with the role supporting HR operations on-site within the HR and payroll team.

Interested?:

Ready to bring your HR and payroll administration skills to a role with real day-to-day value? Apply now for the HR and Payroll Assistant (Maternity Cover) opportunity and take the next step in your people operations career.

title: Junior Accounts Administrator
description:
About the Role

We are currently recruiting a Junior Accounts Administrator to join a well-established manufacturing business based in Cannock.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who is organised, has good attention to detail and is looking to develop their skills within an accounts and finance environment.

Previous accounts experience is not essential. We are equally interested in hearing from candidates with general administration experience who are confident working with numbers and would like to build a career in finance.

Working within a small, friendly team, you will support the day-to-day accounts and administration activities of the business, with training and guidance provided to help you develop your knowledge and confidence.

The Opportunity

This is a varied position offering the chance to gain practical experience across several areas of accounts, including purchase and sales ledger, invoicing and general financial administration.

As you develop your skills and experience, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and become more involved in the wider finance function.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting with the processing of purchase and sales invoices
- Checking invoices against purchase orders and delivery notes
- Helping to raise customer invoices and credit notes
- Updating and maintaining accurate financial records
- Assisting with purchase and sales ledger administration
- Supporting supplier statement and bank reconciliations
- Processing expenses and maintaining relevant documentation
- Helping with credit control and customer payment queries
- Responding to general customer and supplier enquiries
- Maintaining organised filing and record-keeping systems
- Supporting the accounts team with month-end activities
- Providing general office and administrative support as required

About You

We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic, reliable and willing to learn.

You will ideally have:
- Some previous experience in an office or administration environment
- Good attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- Confidence working with numbers
- Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office
- Good organisational and communication skills
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn
- The ability to work as part of a small team
- A flexible approach to supporting different areas of the business

You do not need previous accounts experience to be considered for this position.

Experience in general administration, data entry, customer service or a similar office-based role would provide a good foundation.

An interest in accounts, bookkeeping or working towards an AAT qualification would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Training and support to develop your accounts knowledge
- Opportunity to gain experience across different finance activities
- Potential to take on additional responsibilities as you develop
- Friendly and supportive team environment
- Established and successful manufacturing business

If you are an organised and motivated individual looking for an opportunity to move into accounts and finance, we would love to hear from you.

Whether you already have some accounts knowledge or are looking to develop your career from a general administration background, this could be an excellent next step.

Apply today to find out more.

title: Payroll Officer
salary_text: £17 - £18 per hour (Hybrd Working | 2 Days in Office | Im)
description:
Location: Hybrid

We are seeking an experienced, organised and detail-oriented Payroll Officer. The successful candidate will be responsible for processing payroll, maintaining employee records, ensuring compliance with statutory requirements and providing a high standard of customer service to employees and managers.
Key Responsibilities:
- Process monthly payroll accurately and within agreed deadlines
- Manage payroll changes, including new starters, leavers, salary amendments, contractual changes and employee deductions.
- Calculate and process statutory payments, including SSP, SMP, SPP and other relevant statutory entitlements.
- Ensure payroll information is accurate, complete and compliant with HMRC regulations.
- Process pension contributions and ensure compliance with pension scheme requirements and auto-enrolment legislation.
- Maintain accurate employee payroll records and ensure confidentiality in accordance with GDPR.
- Investigate and resolve payroll queries from employees, managers and external stakeholders.
- Complete payroll reconciliations and identify and resolve discrepancies.
- Support the processing of overtime, additional hours, allowances and other variable payments.
- Prepare and submit payroll information, including RTI submissions to HMRC.

Essential Skills and Experience
- Previous experience working in a Payroll Officer, Payroll Administrator or similar payroll position.
- Good understanding of UK payroll legislation, PAYE, National Insurance and statutory payments.
- Experience processing payroll from start to finish.
- Knowledge of pension contributions and auto-enrolment requirements.

Desirable Experience
- Experience processing payroll within the public sector, local government or a large organisation.
- CIPP qualification or working towards a recognised payroll qualification. Preferred, not essential
- Knowledge of CIVICA payroll reporting and system functionality.
- Experience working across multiple sites or within a hybrid working environment.

Working Arrangements
- This position offers a flexible hybrid working model:
- Stafford: 1 day per week working on-site.
- Telford: 1 day per week working on-site.
- Home Working: 3 days per week working remotely.
- The successful candidate must be able to travel to both Stafford and Telford offices as required.
